name: topicforge
description: Read-only ROS 2 and DDS inspection for Claude: list topics, sample messages, read bags, find QoS mismatches and see who is on the DDS bus. It cannot publish or command a robot.

dds_backend.title: DDS backend
dds_backend.description: One of cyclone, mock or auto. cyclone joins the DDS bus as a read-only participant (needs no ROS 2). mock serves fixed demo data instead. auto picks the best available.

dds_domain_id.title: DDS domain id
dds_domain_id.description: The one DDS domain to observe, 0 to 232. It is fixed at startup; restart to change it.
